page_title: VER 2-2 CAG | Verona v Cagliari 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Federico Dionisi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' What was Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+2' 2 - 2 Mattia Felici (Cagliari) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Lorenzo Montipo with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:2.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Yellow card. Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
86' Fabio Pisacane has decided to make a change. Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) replaces Matteo Prati.
85' Verona take a short corner kick.
81' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gift Orban trots off the pitch and is replaced by Abdou Harroui (Verona).
78' Fabio Pisacane has decided to substitute Marco Palestra and he is replaced by Mattia Felici (Cagliari).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Amin Sarr (Verona) comes onto the pitch so that Giovane can be given a rest.
77' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Adam Obert plays the ball to the feet of Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari), who hits a tremendous first-time shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper was unable to keep it out. 2:1.
76' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) was too forceful with his tackle and Federico Dionisi interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
70' Paolo Zanetti is forced to make a change. Rafik Belghali is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Fallou Cham (Verona).
68' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile is alert and denies him.
66' The game is interrupted. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
65' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Adam Obert (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Federico Dionisi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
64' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
63' Substitution. Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) replaces Gianluca Gaetano.
62' Fabio Pisacane decides to make a substitution. Michael Folorunsho will be replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
61' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Federico Dionisi to decide. The relieved Verona players can finally celebrate.
61' Celebrations by Verona are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
59' 2 - 0 What a goal! Giovane plays it to Gift Orban (Verona), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Elia Caprile into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
57' Victor Nelsson (Verona) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Federico Dionisi didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
56' The resulting corner from Giovane (Verona) comes to nothing.

55' Giovane (Verona) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time effort from inside the six-yard box. The ball was aimed towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt. Verona will take a corner kick.
55' Gift Orban (Verona) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
54' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) is adjudged offside.
53' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) earns the yellow card.
52' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
52' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.
47' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Gift Orban (Verona) heads on.
46' The game is over for Joseph Liteta. Michel Adopo (Cagliari) comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro is replaced by Antoine Bernede (Verona).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Giovane (Verona) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
41' A yellow card for a tackle by Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona). Federico Dionisi doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
39' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
35' Flag up against Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
34' Gift Orban (Verona) tries to head the rebound into the net from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a good save to deny him.
34' Suat Serdar (Verona) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards the middle of the goal and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
33' Giovane (Verona) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
31' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Federico Dionisi blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Cagliari control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
27' Suat Serdar (Verona) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

23' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Giovane flighted in the free kick and the ball found the head of Roberto Gagliardini (Verona), whose excellent bullet header sailed into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
22' Federico Dionisi couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jose Pedro (Cagliari) and blew his whistle. Verona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
19' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
16' Unai Nunez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona).
13' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

13' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
12' Federico Dionisi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Victor Nelsson (Verona).
6' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
5' The resulting set piece from Verona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
4' Giovane (Verona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Good work from Verona as they win a corner.
3' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) blew a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross deep inside the box, but his shot flew just over the bar.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Verona will have the kick-off.
Federico Dionisi is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
